Fabulor downstream Enchant / WinSpell modification
2026-10-29

Based on Enchant 2.8.19:
https://github.com/rrthomas/enchant/tree/v2.8.19
Source archive SHA-256:
c8d70991d544ee39274b96bd01d2858a009fe732ff43f2aaf605fd61ecd06f60

Fabulor's component inventory identifies this distribution as
2.8.19+fabulor-session-local.1. The core's upstream version string remains
2.8.19. This is not a new upstream release.

The build recipe at tools/enchant-msvc/CMakeLists.txt creates a build-local
copy of the upstream WinSpell provider. It leaves the optional add_to_session
and remove_from_session hooks unset, rather than using Windows' persistent
user-dictionary Add/Remove operations for session-only API requests. Enchant
core already maintains session include/exclude tables. Explicit personal-word
persistence continues through Enchant's personal word files.

The original upstream source archive/file and upstream licence text are
unchanged. The recipe also retains the documented MSVC compatibility rewrite
for generated composite.c and the Windows compatibility shims under
tools/enchant-msvc/compat. These build recipes and shims are included in the
Fabulor source tree; the pinned upstream archive supplies the remaining source.

This notice supplements, and does not replace, enchant-COPYING.LIB.
